about: A blue point Siamese: an off-white body with nearly neutral slate-grey points.

palette.body: off-white with a faint warm cast (photos: saturation 0.03-0.10), darkening a little along the back with age; never blue-tinted
palette.points (mask, ears, legs, tail): slate grey, nearly neutral (photos: saturation about 0.10, 0.01-0.20) at about half the body's value, graded into the body

rules: The points are a cool, nearly neutral slate grey, darker than a flame point's (about half the body's value), graded into the body over several texels, never a hard edge.
The body is an off-white, not a blue-white: "blue" names the points' dilute grey, not a blue cast on the coat.
